casting_note: Three career variants each of one female and one male identity; not six independent actors.

figuren.signature: upright wide rounded dumpling ink blob, ONE bent sideways goo crown antenna above small PLUM peaked driver cap with TEAL piping, lashes, TWO tiny offset upper teeth and one big lower tusk. Tiny cream neckerchief, no vehicle/human body.
